scope: Scene02 only. Actual modeling/material/light changes and native/current-source physical evidence; no full-film completion claim.
changes: Five occupied recessed tower storeys, separate balconies, 100 fitted heads, 160 lime panels, 20 seated bells, 8920 closed ceramic units and opaque boarding. Recovered outer tower envelope retained.
Thick timber gable rakes with smaller fitted gilt plates and recessed botanical fields; actual close exposed and then repaired protruding upper coffer corners and oversized slender leaves.
Authored fired-ceramic microstructure, original scanned metric wood grain retained, dark chased PBR lantern castings and actual emitting paper; reduced unshadowed native fill and stronger contact AO.
Distinct weathered exterior bridge red/cedar with lower coat; actual near handrail retains its centreline/external section with a true 31.5 mm corner radius.
Three existing raised galleries now bear on closed granite foundations down to world Y = -0.25 m inside site ground at -0.12 m, with 870 masonry clasts. Their floor/column/roof heights are unchanged.

camera.reason: An eye position 22 cm lower raised the near railing across bridge/pond by roughly 150 pixels, with little change to distant building size. Useful reference frame contacts were better retained by the measured camera.

materialTransfer.sourceOriginalAssets: All original declared compressed source assets remain immutable; the verified exporter retains their file hashes and exports decoded pixels. Every exported binary/image hash is checked before use.
materialTransfer.geometry: All original indexed positions/indices/normals and matrices retained, no decimation. Full affine matrices baked only for shears and metric-timber UV realization.
materialTransfer.RGB: Source vertex RGB only if vertexColors enabled, multiplied separately by exact per-instance RGB. Linked instances read INSTANCER; baked/direct meshes read GEOMETRY.
materialTransfer.timberUV: Original native position/normal, actual instance-column lengths and timberExtent choose longest-axis metric UV exactly by original formula; native phase formula recomputed in CPU double precision, so sin/fract phase can differ from GPU float rounding. UV pixels are original decoded scan maps.
materialTransfer.timberPigment: Original linear material color times normalized decoded linear scan luminance/0.01505120736 with source exponent/clamps; no extra pigment override.
materialTransfer.graniteUV: Original native position/normal and actual instance-column lengths choose the dominant-face metric UV at0.3173828125m per original granite map; native phase formula is recomputed in CPU double precision, so sin/fract phase can differ from native GPU float rounding. Original UV buffers and texture bytes remain in the verified export.
materialTransfer.roughness: Native timber roughness remap ported; individual ceramic source maps, normal maps, clearcoat and all source PBR values retained. The original metric-world wear/wetness formula drives physical floor roughness and clearcoat, with sourceX=worldX and sourceZ=-worldY after the shared coordinate conversion.
materialTransfer.water: Same source pond surface and bump map use physical dielectric IOR1.333/transmission.55/roughness.038, plus actual world-metric 0.17m ripples with1.6mm normal distance instead of the native screen-space offset in place of excluded screen-space reflector.
limits: Native shader leaf transmission is not automatically portable.
Native PMREM/captured-probe, AO, screen-space reflection and ACES differ from physical ray transport and AgX.
Photo fidelity remains unaccepted; Cycles pixels are not WebGL equivalents.

remaining: Exact ornament motifs, carved relief finesse, tile aging and native lighting still differ visibly from the supplied HD source.
Background terrain/woodland and near lotus/flower richness remain less natural and less dense than the photograph.
Current native view is a procedural-scanned 3D reconstruction; physical Cycles still is an independent cross-renderer diagnostic with declared texture/shader/light transfer limits.
commitAndFilm: Parent owns Git integration, publication and full-film assembly; no edits were made to those shared files.

originalAssetPreservation.scope: Original raster and binary glTF assets. New ceramic microstructure is deterministic authored source code, not a modified scan.
